paper.title: Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors

result.summary: 这篇论文提出了一种名为 dropout 的方法，用于缓解前馈神经网络在小训练集上的过拟合问题 [p1]。其核心思想是在每次训练样本呈现时，以 0.5 的概率随机省略一半的隐藏单元，从而阻止特征检测器之间复杂的共适应 [p1][p3]。作者在 MNIST、TIMIT、Reuters、CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet 等多个基准任务上验证了 dropout，报告了在语音和物体识别上的新纪录 [p1][p6][p9][A3.p4][A6.p1][A8.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小训练集上训练时，通常在留出测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1]。原文指出，如果输入与正确输出之间的关系复杂且网络有足够多的隐藏单元来精确建模，通常会有许多不同的权重设置能几乎完美地建模训练集，尤其是当标注训练数据有限时 [p2]。这些权重向量在留出测试数据上会做出不同预测，且几乎都会比在训练数据上表现更差，因为特征检测器被调谐为在训练数据上协同工作，而非在测试数据上 [p2]。

evidence.quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.

If the relationship between the input and the correct output is complicated and the network has enough hidden units to model it accurately, there will typically be many different settings of the weights that can model the training set almost perfectly, especially if there is only a limited amount of labeled training data.

Each of these weight vectors will make different predictions on held-out test data and almost all of them will do worse on the test data than on the training data because the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.

method.text: 论文提出用 dropout 来防止训练数据上的复杂共适应：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，每个隐藏单元以 0.5 的概率被随机从网络中省略，因此隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。dropout 也可视为一种对神经网络进行模型平均的高效方式，它使得在合理时间内训练大量不同网络成为可能，这些网络共享被保留隐藏单元的相同权重 [p3]。训练采用标准随机梯度下降，但修改了惩罚项：不再惩罚整个权重向量的平方长度，而是对每个隐藏单元的输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束，则通过除法重新归一化该隐藏单元的权重 [p4]。

evidence.quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
Random dropout makes it possible to train a huge number of different networks in a reasonable time.
There is almost certainly a different network for each presentation of each training case but all of these networks share the same weights for the hidden units that are present.

We use the standard, stochastic gradient descent procedure for training the dropout neural networks on mini-batches of training cases, but we modify the penalty term that is normally used to prevent the weights from growing too large.
Instead of penalizing the squared length (L2 norm) of the whole weight vector, we set an upper bound on the L2 norm of the incoming weight vector for each individual hidden unit.
If a weight-update violates this constraint, we renormalize the weights of the hidden unit by division.

experiments.text: 论文在多个基准数据集上验证 dropout。在 MNIST 上，使用 60,000 张 28x28 训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像，对隐藏单元使用 50% dropout 并对每个隐藏单元的输入权重施加单独的 L2 约束，将标准前馈神经网络的最佳已发表结果从 160 个错误降至约 130 个错误，再对随机 20% 的像素也进行 dropout 后进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。在 TIMIT 上，输入为 21 个相邻帧、每帧前进 10ms，网络有 4 个全连接隐藏层、每层 4000 个单元和 185 个 softmax 输出单元，50% 隐藏单元 dropout 显著改善分类 [p9]。在 Reuters 上，使用 50 个类别、402,738 篇文档，每篇文档用 2000 个最频繁非停用词表示，训练了 2000-2000-1000-50 架构的网络 [A3.p2][A3.p3]。此外还在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet 上使用深度前馈卷积神经网络进行实验 [A6.p1][A8.p3]。

evidence.quote: It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
Without using any of these tricks, the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set.

This can be reduced to about 130 errors by using 50% dropout with separate L2 constraints on the incoming weights of each hidden unit and further reduced to about 110 errors by also dropping out a random 20% of the pixels (see figure 1).
The input to the net is 21 adjacent frames with an advance of 10ms per frame.
The neural net has 4 fully-connected hidden layers of 4000 units per layer and 185 “softmax” output units that are subsequently merged into the 39 distinct classes used for the benchmark.
Dropout of 50% of the hidden units significantly improves classification for a variety of different network architectures (see figure 2).
This left us with 50 classes and 402,738 documents.
Each document was represented using the 2000 most frequent non-stopwords in the dataset.
We used a 2000-2000-1000-50 architecture.
Our models for CIFAR-10 and ImageNet are deep, feed-forward convolutional neural networks (CNNs).

What we wanted to demonstrate is that dropout is a significant help even for the very complex neural nets that have been developed by the joint efforts of many groups over many years to be really good at object recognition.

findings.text: 在 MNIST 上，50% dropout 配合每个隐藏单元输入权重的单独 L2 约束将标准前馈神经网络的最佳已发表结果从 160 个错误降至约 130 个错误，再对随机 20% 像素 dropout 后进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。在 TIMIT 上，无 dropout 时识别率为 22.7%，有 dropout 时改善至 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息的方法的纪录 [p9]。在 Reuters 上，dropout 同样带来显著改进，学习不仅产生更好的泛化，而且进展平滑，无需早停 [A3.p4]。在特征层面，dropout 学到的特征更简单、看起来像笔画，而标准反向传播学到的特征难以解释，这证实 dropout 迫使判别模型学习更少共适应的好特征并带来更好泛化 [A1.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: This can be reduced to about 130 errors by using 50% dropout with separate L2 constraints on the incoming weights of each hidden unit and further reduced to about 110 errors by also dropping out a random 20% of the pixels (see figure 1).
Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %, which is a record for methods that do not use any information about speaker identity.
As in all previous datasets discussed so far, we obtain significant improvements here too.
The learning not only results in better generalization, but also proceeds smoothly, without the need for early stopping.
The features that dropout learns are simpler and look like strokes, whereas the ones learned by standard backpropagation are difficult to interpret.
This confirms that dropout indeed forces the discriminative model to learn good features which are less co-adapted and leads to better generalization.
